args:
minimum=24
program=node
marker=__ENHANCE_NODE_PATH__
host_path=$PATH
between_markers() { awk -v m="$marker" '{ text = text $0 "\n" } END { n = split(text, part, m); if (n >= 3) { sub(/\n$/, "", part[n - 1]); printf "%s", part[n - 1] } }'; }
person_shell=${SHELL:-}
if [ -z "$person_shell" ]; then
  account=$(id -un 2>/dev/null)
  if command -v getent >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    person_shell=$(getent passwd "$account" | cut -d: -f7)
  else
    person_shell=$(id -P "$account" 2>/dev/null | cut -d: -f10)
  fi
fi
probe="command -v $program >/dev/null 2>&1 && $program -v >/dev/null 2>&1; printf '%s' $marker; printenv PATH; printf '%s' $marker; exit"
system_path=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin
shell_path=
if [ -n "$person_shell" ] && [ -x "$person_shell" ]; then
  shell_path=$(PATH=$system_path DISABLE_AUTO_UPDATE=true "$person_shell" -i -l -c "$probe" </dev/null 2>/dev/null | between_markers)
fi
login_path=$(PATH=$system_path sh -l -c "$probe" </dev/null 2>/dev/null | between_markers)
found_any=
try_source() {
  [ -n "$1" ] || return 1
  candidate=$(PATH=$1; command -v "$program" 2>/dev/null)
  case $candidate in /*) ;; *) return 1 ;; esac
  [ -x "$candidate" ] || return 1
  found_any=1
  version=$("$candidate" -p process.versions.node </dev/null 2>/dev/null)
  major=${version%%.*}
  case $major in
    "" | *[!0-9]*) version="(no version)" ;;
    *) if [ "$major" -ge "$minimum" ]; then chosen=$candidate; chosen_path=$1; return 0; fi ;;
  esac
  printf 'Enhance passed over Node.js %s at %s from %s, because it needs Node.js %s or later.\n' "$version" "$candidate" "$2" "$minimum" >&2
  return 1
}
if try_source "$shell_path" "your shell"; then source="your shell"
elif try_source "$login_path" "your login profile"; then source="your login profile"
elif try_source "$host_path" "this app's PATH"; then source="this app's PATH"
elif [ -n "$found_any" ]; then
  printf 'Enhance needs Node.js %s or later, and found only older versions. Install Node.js %s or later, then restart this app.\n' "$minimum" "$minimum" >&2
  exit 127
else
  printf '%s\n' 'Enhance could not find Node.js. Install Node.js, or make node available in your login shell, then restart this app.' >&2
  exit 127
fi
PATH=$chosen_path
export PATH
printf 'Enhance is using Node.js at %s, found through %s.\n' "$chosen" "$source" >&2
exec "$chosen" "$1"
